summary: Secures 2nd rank in mangrove plantation area under Shoreline Habitats initiative behind Gujarat.

blocks.text: 🪝 Andhra Pradesh Ranks 2nd Nationally in MISHTI Mangrove Restoration. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Secures 2nd rank in mangrove plantation area under Shoreline Habitats initiative behind Gujarat.
State Rankings: Gujarat ranks 1st in total plantation area; Andhra Pradesh 2nd.
MISHTI Scheme: Launched June 5, 2023 for 540 sq. km. mangrove restoration across 9 states and 4 UTs.
National Cover: West Bengal holds 42.45% of national mangrove cover (Sundarbans).
1st rank mangrove plantation (Gujarat) vs largest national mangrove cover share (West Bengal, 42.45%).
